title: Form
description: A formancy form, written against version 0 of the spec. The document holds the data contract only: what the form collects, and under what names. How it looks and when it appears are separate concerns, so the same form can have more than one presentation.

specVersion.title: Spec version
specVersion.description: Which version of the formancy spec this form is written against. Always "0" today. It is independent of the package version, and it only changes when the shape of the document changes.

id.title: Form ID
id.description: The form's stable identifier. It appears in the form's URL and in exported data, so choose it once and leave it alone: changing it breaks existing links and detaches the submissions already collected.

title.title: Title
title.description: The form's name, as the person filling it in will read it at the top of the page.

formId.title: Form ID
formId.description: A short URL-safe name: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, beginning with a letter or a digit.

model.title: Data model
model.description: The data contract of the form: its fields, and the names their answers are stored under. Presentation and conditional logic live outside the model, which is why one model can be shown in more than one way.

fields.title: Fields
fields.description: The fields of the form, in the order the reader meets them. Order is presentation: a field is identified by its key, so moving one up or down does not change the data you have already collected.

field.title: Field
field.description: One field of the form. Most fields collect a single answer; a group, a page and a repeater collect nothing themselves and hold other fields instead.

required.title: Required
required.description: Whether the form can be sent without an answer to this field. Turning this on for a field that already exists invalidates the submissions that left it empty, so publishing reports it as a lossy change.

renamedFrom.title: Renamed from
renamedFrom.description: The key this field used to be called. Set it in the same edit that changes the key and the answers already collected follow the field across. The old key must be gone from this form: if a field still uses it, you have made a copy rather than a rename, and the two would fight over the same answers.

leafField.title: Answer field
leafField.description: A field that collects one answer and holds no other fields.

containerField.title: Container field
containerField.description: A group, a page or a repeater. It collects no answer of its own; the fields inside it do.

fields.title: Child fields
fields.description: The fields held inside this container. Their keys are unique across the whole form, not just within the container.

fieldKey.title: Key
fieldKey.description: The name this field's answer is stored under, and the field's identity for as long as the form exists. It becomes a column in exported data and a variable in logic expressions, so it has to read like an identifier: a letter or an underscore, then letters, digits or underscores. Changing a key is a data migration rather than an edit, so say where it came from with "renamedFrom".

fieldType.title: Field type
fieldType.description: What kind of answer the field collects, or — for a group, a page or a repeater — how it holds the fields inside it. The type decides which control the reader sees and how the answer is stored, so changing it on a live form may leave existing answers unreadable.

oneOf.title: Single-line text
oneOf.description: One line of free text: a name, a reference, a short answer.

oneOf.title: Multi-line text
oneOf.description: A box several lines tall, for a message or a description.

oneOf.title: Number
oneOf.description: A numeric answer, for amounts and counts. Do not use it for phone numbers, postcodes or account numbers: those lose their leading zeros.

oneOf.title: Checkbox
oneOf.description: A single yes-or-no answer, such as accepting the terms.

oneOf.title: Dropdown
oneOf.description: One answer picked from a list, shown collapsed. Best when the list is long.

oneOf.title: Radio buttons
oneOf.description: One answer picked from a list, with every option visible at once. Best for a handful of options.

oneOf.title: Date
oneOf.description: A calendar date, with no time of day.

oneOf.title: Hidden value
oneOf.description: Travels with the submission but is never shown to the reader, such as a campaign code or a referral source.

oneOf.title: Static text
oneOf.description: Text shown to the reader that collects nothing: a heading, an explanation, a notice.

oneOf.title: Group
oneOf.description: Related fields kept together on the same page. Collects nothing itself.

oneOf.title: Page
oneOf.description: One step of a form split over several screens. Collects nothing itself.

oneOf.title: Repeater
oneOf.description: A set of fields the reader can fill in more than once, such as one block per passenger. A repeater cannot be placed inside another repeater in this version of the spec.
